ruleDefinitions.name: AWS ECS Task Definition That Queries The Credential Endpoint
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects when an Elastic Container Service (ECS) Task Definition includes a command to query the credential endpoint.
This can indicate a potential adversary adding a backdoor to establish persistence or escalate privileges.
 Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName, requestParameters.containerDefinitions.command

sequences.query: (eventSource = "ecs\.amazonaws\.com" AND (eventName = "DescribeTaskDefinition" OR eventName = "RegisterTaskDefinition" OR eventName = "RunTask") AND requestParameters.containerDefinitions.command = RGX(".*\\$AWS\\_CONTAINER\\_CREDENTIALS\\_RELATIVE\\_URI.*"))
